Also causes 2 [[Split (Polluted Wasteland)|Split]]s to be spawned. }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|These things may be slow, but they make up for that in EXPLOSIVE repercussions!
Boomers will, well, go BOOM when they die, stunning towers!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 34 ([[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} {{QuoteBox|Incoming enemy!|Beginning of Wave 34 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Golden Mode|Golden]] & [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ == Description == The '''Splitter''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared in [[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, replacing the [[Boomer]]. While replacing the [[Boomer]] whenever it was meant to spawn in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode in [[Polluted Wasteland]], the '''Splitter''' had much more health than the [[Boomer]]. However, the '''Splitter''' moved much more slower compared to the [[Boomer]]. In addition upon its death, as well as stunning towers in a large radius, it spawned two [[Split (Polluted Wasteland)|Split]]s. The '''Splitter''' used to be spawned from the [[Mystery Boss]] upon its death in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode in [[Polluted Wasteland]], wave 35 onwards. ==Appearance== The '''Splitter''' had green skin and a large bloated stomach. Its navel was dark green. It wore black shorts and had grey legs. Its eyes were white, and a radioactive substance leaked out of its eyes and mouth. Green particles were emitted from its torso. == Strategy == *The '''Splitter''' can stun towers upon its death. This allows other [[enemies]] to pass stunned towers with little damage being done to them. **While the '''Splitter''' has incredibly slow speed, it should be killed as soon as possible, and as far away from your main towers as possible. *The [[Rocketeer]] or [[Mortar]] are recommended against the '''Splitter''' as it will spawn two fast [[Split (Polluted Wasteland)|Split]]s when it dies. *Killing the '''Splitter''' before it gets within range of most of your towers is the most ideal way to deal with it. Keep in mind that it also has a long stun time. **The [[Ranger]] is the best at keeping distance away from the '''Splitter'''. Long range towers, such as [[Minigunner]] and [[Turret]], are also excellent options. *The [[DJ Booth]] allows towers to shoot the '''Splitter''' from further away, potentially killing it before it can stun your towers. *You can use the [[Medic]]'s ability to cleanse your towers of the '''Splitter's''' stun, so long it is not stunned itself. *If a '''Splitter''' is near the end of the path on low health, try not to kill it and let it enter the base. When it is killed, it will spawn two [[Split (Polluted Wasteland)|Split]]s which can easily run into your base and result in a defeat. == Trivia == *This [[Enemies|enemy]] is very similar to the removed [[Carrier]] as that enemy also spawned a smaller enemy upon its death. *The [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] improperly calls this enemy as a [[Boomer]]. *The '''Splitter's''' legs are the same legs of the second version of the [[Tank]]. *The '''Splitter''' was effectively replaced by the [[Super Slime]] in [[Polluted Wasteland II]], as both have very similar mechanics. **Later on, an identically named enemy, [[Splitter]], would also be added, though functionally the [[Super Slime]] is far closer to the '''Splitter''' than the new [[Splitter]] enemy. *The '''Splitter''' is similar to the [[Breaker2|Br]][[Breaker3|ea]][[Breaker4|ker]] enemies. == Update History == *'''29 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.10|Release v1.10.0]] **'''Splitter''' added. *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.11|Release v1.11.0]] **Can no longer be spawned from the [[Summoner Boss]]. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **[[Partial Electric Immunity]] replaced with [[Energy Immunity]]. **No longer appears in Golden mode as it has been removed. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Splitter''' removed. {{GoldenNuclear|[[Tank]]|Wave 30|Splitter|Wave 34|[[Summoner Boss]]|Wave 36}} {{FallenNuclear|[[Mystery Boss]]|Wave 32|Splitter|Wave 34|[[Templar]]|Wave 35}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Polluted Wasteland]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:Splitter}}
